const soNoDisplay = soData.so_no;
const soID = [soData.id];
let siLineItem = [];
let lineCounter = 0;
for(const item of soData.table_so) {
  const lineItemPromise = mapLineItem(item, soData, lineCounter);
  siLineItem.push(lineItemPromise);
  lineCounter++;
}
const siData = mapHeaderData(soData, siLineItem, soNoDisplay, soID);


return { siData };
